meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Cross-reviewed new shared article retrieval used by the Enterprise and Support context, with published-only filtering and no private chat tool access.

auth.review_note: Checked owner-only administration, CSRF guards, scoped MCP digest records and revocation, and private guide access across both agent surfaces.

commerce.review_note: Reconciled issued document sequence exports against stored invoice evidence and checked protected MCP sales aggregates against dashboard definitions.

content.review_note: Reviewed published Markdown source, future/draft/symlink filtering and bounded article metadata against blog and customer help documentation.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the Git-head reader for detached, loose, packed and invalid refs; no shell on public requests, no MySQL fallback and no user-selected file paths; checked Hostinger release instructions.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed public header layout changes alongside Google tag insertion: tag output, consent settings, and verification markup are untouched by mobile navigation restoration.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed exact safe deployment revision HTTP 200 match/mismatch, 400 malformed SHA, 503 missing Git metadata, no-store responses and absence of path or credential leakage.

interface.review_note: Reviewed pre-bottom-nav mobile branding, current floating cart and support controls, header accessibility, compact screen spacing and cart checkout dock offset without payment mutation.

mail.review_note: Verified editorial page and article preview, scheduling and save paths maintain separation from newsletter and order email dispatch.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed updated shop documentation and existing local MCP client behavior: restored mobile cart affordance does not alter public MCP schemas, grants, or client scope.

media.review_note: Reviewed deployment documentation and confirmed media storage and protected file paths remain independent of public article metadata.

operator-help.review_note: Compared unchanged authenticated help routes and views with the new public SHA lookup, which never reads operator guides or chat histories.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the main CI fixtures and separate verified-deployment workflow: exact SHA comparison, bounded polling, isolated live guest cart add/remove and no production payment or credential operation.
